summary: Busy Hawken Drive kerb with homes 1-10 m from nearly all of it.

best_section.where: Hawken Drive east kerb, between the first houses and the apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 7 m (17 m), 6 m (38 m), 6 m (60 m), 1 m (74 m) and 7 m (82 m) line the whole kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb of a wide through road; room to stand but no verge or pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Busy road linking suburbs, with a crossing and island near the end.
drivers.convention: 2P resident-permit and bus zone signs; only one or two cars parked.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m along the stretch
Slope up to 7.2% at the start
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade parts of the kerb from the east.
